answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates Sybil resistance by anchoring digital identity to physical uniqueness. Like planting a yarrow stalk to mark a boundary in an orchard, agents must verify their biological nature to participate. This forces an attacker into a downward spiral of increasing logistical complexity, as the cost of acquiring fake biometric markers scales linearly with identity count, rendering large-scale Sybil flooding economically unsustainable.
